units.source_text: 包括良子在內，我們四個人在汽車上顛簸了很長時間，直到天快黑時，才抵達了森林中的一家醫院的門口。

en.t: Including Yoshiko, the four of us were jolted around in the car for a long time, and only when it was nearly dark did we arrive at the entrance of a hospital in the forest.

units.source_text: 我以為是一家結核病的療養院。

en.t: I thought it was a tuberculosis sanatorium.

units.source_text: 我接受了一名年輕醫生親切而又細緻的檢查。

en.t: A young doctor examined me with kindness and great care.

units.source_text: 然後，這位醫師靦腆地笑著對我說：「好了，你就在這裡靜養一段吧。」

en.t: Then the doctor smiled shyly and said to me, "Well, you should rest here quietly for a while."

units.source_text: 比目魚、堀木、良子把我一個人留下，都回去了，

en.t: Hirame, Horiki, and Yoshiko left me there alone and all went home.

units.source_text: 良子臨走前還交給我一個裝有換洗衣服的包袱，然後悄悄地從腰帶間取出注射器和用剩下的藥品。

en.t: Before leaving, Yoshiko handed me a bundle with a change of clothes in it, then quietly took the syringe and the leftover medicine from inside her sash.

units.source_text: 她好像真的認為那就是壯陽藥呢。

en.t: She really seemed to believe it was an aphrodisiac.
"No, I do not need it anymore."

units.source_text: 這其實是很少見的一件事。

en.t: That was actually a very rare thing.
